agent_landing.badge: Free forever for your daily work
agent_landing.hero_title: Your whole book, on the phone in your hand.
agent_landing.hero_subtitle: Leads, renewals, every customer and every policy — in one place instead of a diary, three WhatsApp groups and an Excel sheet. Built for how advisors in India actually work.
agent_landing.trust_language: Works in English, Hindi and Hinglish
agent_landing.trust_yours: Your customers stay yours. We never contact them.
agent_landing.replaces_3: an Excel sheet you keep re-saving
agent_landing.caps_heading: The whole job, not one clever trick
agent_landing.caps_sub: Every one of these is in the portal today. The daily work costs nothing — you pay only when you want more policy checks.
agent_landing.cap_leads_desc: New, contacted, interested, won, lost — and who you promised to ring back today.
agent_landing.cap_renewals_desc: Everything due in the next 30 days, sorted by how close it is.
agent_landing.cap_book_desc: Every customer, their family, every policy they hold. Export to Excel whenever you like.
agent_landing.cap_checks_desc: Read the fine print of any policy and get the limits, caps and gaps in plain language.
agent_landing.cap_compare_desc: Two plans side by side in the words a customer actually asks about.
agent_landing.cap_claims_desc: Where a claim is stuck, what the insurer asked for, who is waiting on you.
agent_landing.cap_calc_desc: How much cover a family actually needs, as a report you can send them.
agent_landing.cap_page_desc: A page with your name and photo that customers can find and message you on.
agent_landing.b1_heading: Nobody’s policy lapses because it slipped your mind.
agent_landing.b1_body: Every policy due in the next thirty days, in order, with the message already written — English, Hindi or Hinglish. You read it, change what you want, and send it from your own WhatsApp.
agent_landing.b2_heading: Walk into the meeting already knowing what the policy will not pay.
agent_landing.b2_body: Upload any policy — health, motor, term life, travel — and get the caps, co-pays, waiting periods and gaps in plain language, as a report with your name on it. Three checks free to try, twelve a month on the paid plan.
agent_landing.check_clause_1_desc: A ₹12,000 room means she pays a share of every line on the bill.
agent_landing.check_clause_2: Knee and hip: 3 years to go
agent_landing.b3_heading: One screen that shows where the month actually went.
agent_landing.b3_body: Not a vanity chart. What you got through, what is still open, and what is coming at you next week — so you know on the 3rd whether the 30th is going to hurt.
agent_landing.month_item_3: 2 leads you said you would call back
agent_landing.price_heading: Free where it should be free
agent_landing.price_sub: Your leads, renewals and client book cost nothing. You pay only when you want more policy checks.
agent_landing.tier_free_desc: Leads, renewals, client book, Cover Calculator, WhatsApp drafts. 3 policy checks to try, 20 policies of data entry.
agent_landing.tier_agent_desc: 12 policy checks a month, 50 data-entry policies, Sach for policy questions, priority support.
agent_landing.tier_agency_desc: Everything in Agent for every seat, 10 checks a seat you can move between advisors, and one place to manage the team. Minimum 5 seats.
agent_landing.final_heading: Start with the free half. Pay only if the rest earns it.
agent_landing.final_sub: No card, no trial clock counting down. Your customers stay yours — we never contact them, and we never sell a lead.
agent_landing.contact_heading: Would rather talk to a person first?
